gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic keeps its small letters wide open and its x-height pronounced, which gives every line a clean, modern look. Audiowide's futuristic, tile-like glyphs are what you remember.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sen: Autour One is bold and expressive, with a clear channel leading into each round letter and no hairline-to-stem shift. Sen traces each letter in one constant-weight line, so extended reading should move along smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sintony: Wide and commanding: Goldman spaces its letters generously and rounds them like open parentheses. Sintony then adds a chunky midzone and smooth curves that never clog, giving the display lettering a sturdy partner.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sofia-sans: Open-sided, rounded lowercase gives the text a modern read, while Grandstander up top brings bold, expressive lines of constant width. Sofia Sans draws every stroke without any thick-and-thin modulation, and that uniformity ties the pair together.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-osage: Noto Sans Osage fills each line with inflated bowls and sweeping open curves, softening the dark, aggressive mood of Eater. Longer paragraphs should feel approachable, never cramped or menacing.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Futuristic and techy, Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines. Noto Sans Armenian has full, inviting round letters, which should keep extended reading approachable and comfortable.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-aldrich: Distinctive from the first letter, Gugi cuts its terminals open. Aldrich keeps its x-height close to the cap height and cups its round letters, so longer text should read with a smooth, modern rhythm.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-alexandria: Gugi is distinctive and bold, with terminals cut open so its counters flow outward and curves that match its stems. Alexandria's generous c openings make it the cleaner, quieter partner.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-devanagari: Distinctly open letter mouths keep the text modern and open, while Gugi's tube-like strokes hold their thickness through every bend. Anek Devanagari should carry extended reading with an unfussy, open-mouthed ease.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-gujarati: Gugi is bold and distinctive, drawn with pencil-line consistency. Where Gugi grabs attention with display punch, Anek Gujarati quietly delivers a lowercase that rivals the capitals and a gaping c opening.
